analysis.insight_summary: Users are looking for guidance to set up communication between [product_name] controllers, focusing on data exchange and system setup. There is uncertainty about connection limits, such as whether connecting up to 270 client controllers is feasible. The need for well-documented example projects—ideally in English—is highlighted, with appreciation for shared resources and practical examples from the community.
analysis.user_expectations: Users want clear, well-documented steps or sample projects for establishing communication between [product_name] controllers and information on system constraints regarding the maximum number of client connections.
